purpose: Project-owned profile for Lisan Studio MSI upgrade, same-version replace, downgrade refusal, and uninstall registry validation in the isolated LisanStudio-QA runner.
phases: stage earlier and replacement MSI artifacts in LisanStudio-QA
run same-version reinstall leaves exactly one uninstall entry
run upgrade replacement from earlier version to replacement version
run downgrade refusal keeps the replacement install active
collect MSI logs, registry snapshots, and result JSON
uninstall unless KeepInstalled is explicitly requested

inputs.earlierMsiPath: Path to a staged previous private beta MSI inside the approved guest lane.
inputs.replacementMsiPath: Path to the current staged private beta MSI inside the approved guest lane.
inputs.downgradeMsiPath: Optional path to an older MSI used to verify downgrade refusal after the replacement is active.

notes: This profile records the upgrade coverage contract only. Running it installs/uninstalls MSI packages and therefore requires the approved LisanStudio-QA lane, not active WHITEDRAGON.
